Dev Diary: Why 3mpwrApp Will Always Be Free
The thinking behind our permanent free commitment a an ethical stance, not a growth strategy
Key points:
- Monetizing disability data would be a direct betrayal of the community we serve
- Paywalling critical features creates a two-tiered system of access to justice
- Sustainable through grants and advocacy partnerships a not user fees or advertising
